name: JSON Schema Validate
description: Validates YAML/JSON files against a JSON schema

schema.description: URL or file path to JSON schema to validate against

files.description: Multiline input of file paths to validate - supports globs

fail-on-invalid.description: Whether or not to set action failure if a file is invalid

cache-remote-schema.description: Whether or not to cache the schema if remote

all-errors.description: Report all errors instead of stopping at the first

custom-errors.description: Enable support for custom error messages using ajv-errors
